immutable_rule: v0.10 and earlier parent bytes plus the exact failed-v0.11 predecessor baseline are immutable. Every other shipped path must match exactly one retry-successor selector after immutable precedence.

protected_parent_selector.rule: Union of v0.10 MANIFEST content_hash keys plus protected_release_manifests.

failed_predecessor_selector.rule: Exact paths+hashes in FAILED-PREDECESSOR-v0.11-BASELINE.json; must be disjoint from protected parent.

evidence_preservation_override: Retry-successor ownership is not blanket write permission. Once a retry artifact is hash-bound by review/freeze evidence, that more specific evidence-preservation rule makes it immutable.
explicitly_not_authorized: write implementation outside reserved v0.11.1 namespaces
weaken v0.11 structural targets to obtain a retry pass
